# Zvirox

> Open-source video, audio, and TV software for Linux and Android TV.

Zvirox is an independent open-source software project founded and maintained solo by Prakashpuri Gauswami (@Prakash) in Gujarat, India. The project builds high-performance, local-first applications designed for Linux and Android TV that respect user privacy, send zero telemetry, and ship Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers so AI coding agents can operate them natively.

Website: https://zvirox.in
Contact: info@zvirox.in | zvirox@proton.me
GitHub Organization: https://github.com/zvirox

## Open-Source Software Projects

- [Easy Edits Pro (EEP)](https://zvirox.in/projects/eep/): Active alpha Linux desktop video editor built with Rust, Tauri, React, and GStreamer. Combines a multitrack timeline with a Rust-owned transactional project model. Shipped with 440 editor commands, 7 workspaces, a CLI, and an MCP server. AGPL-3.0 with commercial licensing option.
  - Repository: https://github.com/zvirox/easy-edits-pro
- [Audio Labs Pro (ALP)](https://zvirox.in/projects/alp/): Alpha v0.0.1 Linux audio studio built with Rust and iced. Features multitrack recording, mixing, CLAP/LV2 plugin hosting, offline local AI voice cloning, and a 14-tool Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Apache-2.0.
  - Repository: https://github.com/zvirox/audio-labs-pro
- [Screen Studio Pro (SSP)](https://zvirox.in/projects/ssp/): Planned open-source Wayland screen recorder for Linux with a frosted-glass UI, PipeWire capture, webcam picture-in-picture, and hardware-first encoding. Currently in specification phase. MIT.
  - Repository: https://github.com/zvirox/screen-studio-pro
- [Your TV Friend (YTF)](https://zvirox.in/projects/ytf/): v0.0.3 Android TV non-destructive debloater and native television launcher (Your UI). Disables OEM bloatware reversibly via ADB without root. Features 5 customizable visual themes, 26 languages, and 297 catalogued device profiles. MIT.
  - Repository: https://github.com/zvirox/your-tv-friend

## Core Technical Guides & Architecture Notes

- [Voice & Audio AI](https://zvirox.in/categories/voice-audio-ai/): Local voice cloning, text-to-speech, and audio privacy.
  - [VoiceStudio Review](https://zvirox.in/voice-audio-ai/voicestudio-review-local-ai-voice-cloning/): Hands-on review of offline voice cloning in 646 languages.
  - [Running Voice AI Locally](https://zvirox.in/voice-audio-ai/running-voice-ai-locally-privacy-first-tts/): Privacy-first alternatives to cloud TTS engines.
  - [From ElevenLabs to VoiceStudio](https://zvirox.in/voice-audio-ai/from-elevenlabs-to-voicestudio-migration-guide/): On-premises voice cloning migration guide.
- [AI & Coding Agents](https://zvirox.in/categories/ai/): Model-agnostic workflows and AI agents.
  - [Kilo AI vs Cursor](https://zvirox.in/ai/kilo-ai-vs-cursor-open-source-coding-agent/): Model-agnostic AI coding agent comparison with BYOK.
  - [AI Coding Agents in 2026](https://zvirox.in/ai/ai-coding-agents-2026-model-agnostic-byok/): State of agentic development and local models.
- [Linux Systems & Networking](https://zvirox.in/categories/linux/):
  - [What Is SSH?](https://zvirox.in/linux/what-is-ssh/): Secure Shell fundamentals, cryptographic key pairs, and hardening.
  - [What Is DNS?](https://zvirox.in/networking/what-is-dns/): Recursive and authoritative DNS resolution architecture.
  - [What Is DHCP?](https://zvirox.in/networking/what-is-dhcp/): DORA protocol and dynamic address leasing.
  - [What Is the OSI Model?](https://zvirox.in/networking/what-is-osi-model/): 7-layer networking architecture.
